default.title: Check you are eligible
default.text: Answer ten questions about your job offer, salary and English level. We tell you straight away whether you qualify and which route fits.

default.title: Gather your documents
default.text: You get a personal checklist: passport, certificate of sponsorship, proof of savings and any translations. Upload each one as you find it.

default.title: We submit your application
default.text: Your caseworker reviews every page with you on a video call, then files the application and pays the fees on your behalf.

default.title: Give your fingerprints and photo
default.text: Book a biometrics appointment at a centre near you. We send directions and a list of what to bring the day before.

default.title: Get your decision
default.text: Most decisions arrive within three weeks. We track your case daily and call you the moment it lands.
